name: Skills Build and Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'cmd/thv-operator/**'
      - 'pkg/**'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - '.github/workflows/skills-build-and-publish.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'cmd/thv-operator/**'
      - 'pkg/**'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - '.github/workflows/skills-build-and-publish.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Operator
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@7a3fe6cf4cb3a834922a1244abfce67bcef6a0c5 # v6
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Install Task
        uses: arduino/setup-task@b91d5d2c96a56797b48ac1e0e89220bf64044611 # v2
        with:
          version: 3.44.1
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build Operator
        run: |
          task build-operator

      - name: Upload Operator binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: thv-operator
          path: ./bin/thv-operator
          retention-days: 1

  test:
    name: Test Operator
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@7a3fe6cf4cb3a834922a1244abfce67bcef6a0c5 # v6
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Download Operator binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@8da327e4201f9018511001382a71420111000000 # v4
        with:
          name: thv-operator
          path: ./bin/

      - name: Make binary executable
        run: chmod +x ./bin/thv-operator

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test -v ./cmd/thv-operator/... -coverprofile=coverage.out
          go tool cover -func=coverage.out

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@7a3fe6cf4cb3a834922a1244abfce67bcef6a0c5 # v6
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: latest
          args: --timeout=5m

  security-scan:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@7a3fe6cf4cb3a834922a1244abfce67bcef6a0c5 # v6
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Run govulncheck
        run: |
          go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest
          govulncheck ./...

  e2e-tests:
    name: E2E Tests
    needs: [build, test, lint, security-scan]
    uses: ./.github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml
    secrets: inherit

  helm-charts-test:
    name: Helm Charts Test
    needs: [build, test, lint, security-scan]
    uses: ./.github/workflows/helm-charts-test.yml
    secrets: inherit

  all-checks-pass:
    name: All Checks Pass
    if: always()
    needs:
      - build
      - test
      - lint
      - security-scan
      - e2e-tests
      - helm-charts-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if all dependent jobs passed
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
